blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar has filed Senate Bill No. 1272 — or the proposed Kabalikat sa Hanapbuhay Act — which seeks to cut the cost of securing employment by granting discounts and fee waivers on essential pre-employment documents for indigent Filipinos, “Being short of money should not be a barrier for Filipinos looking for a job. Through this proposal, we want to lessen their expenses in getting necessary documents so that they can focus on looking for a job and start their livelihood,” Villar said in Filipino in a statement. According to Villar, he got the idea for the proposal […]... Keep on reading: Mark Villar files bill to cut job-seeking costs for indigent Filipinos
